observations: Foreground soup remains cropped by right/bottom; seated neighbors and flutist diminish continuously across the frame.
Blue-green contours and amber accents are dense near food/people, lighter on distant scene. The composition remains an intimate adult gathering.

substantive_visual.evidence: The large near soup and cups, middle eating/listening neighbors and far-left flutist share sightlines and a continuous seating diagonal. This relationship occupies most of the frame rather than isolated activity pictures.

information_relationship.observations: At thumbnail the title and foreground soup are strong anchors, linked by listening figures. At720 identity/date → upper-right venue/arrival → adjacent purchase/participation → near-cup reminder → lower-left invitation is findable. Text is kept clear of contours.

function_contact.observations: Flute held by two clearly separate hands at mouth; seated neighbors hold bowls/cups; serving ladle is coherently resting in the soup bowl. The meal and musician remain visibly shared by listeners.

local_finish.observations: Warm amber lanterns, dark blue-green ink and green food are consistent. Soup rim/ladle/near cups have legible overlaps and clean edges. No typography clipped by crop.

format.observations: One flat opaque landscape poster. No logo, QR, watermark, identifiable real business/performer or extra printed copy observed.

basic_style_exclusion.observation: Former broad pale text-bearing walls have been removed. Irregular leafy dark silhouettes bound title/date; venue and purchase groups sit above different listener heads. The cropped soup and linked humans are the substantial visual construction and dominate scene area. Remaining clear lettering pockets and an upper-right separator do not turn the continuous image into subordinate pictures on a passive solid/split field.

located_observations.observation: Pale wall fields are replaced by irregular leafy silhouettes; title has changed to pale lettering and right purchase group now sits beside venue rather than below it.
Purchase/participation are the smallest text, still individually readable at this view. Venue and entry remain close; no omitted word or symbol observed.

located_observations.observation: Soup, listening adults and flutist form a single asymmetric depth sweep; title sits within its inner bend.

residuals: Purchase and participation remain compact at usage720 relative to the venue; they are legible at that inspected size but no smaller-screen readability is claimed.
Raster shapes support optical text transcription, not source Unicode code-point certification.
